messages.author: 83d59c07601a6f59
messages.subject: Error : INDEX OPERATOR [] OUT OF BOUNDS; can't find what is causing it
parts:
It's seems that the error I get is related to indexing in the for loops of the model but can't find what's causing it. My model , data an error are below (I'm using Rstan): 

In addition, can I index a matrix by doing theta[n][2:4] for instance? I have used the tail and head functions but got an error when trying to index a few elements of theta.

modStan <-
  "
data {
int<lower=0>  N;
int<lower=1>  P;
vector[P]     Y[N];
int<lower=1>  K; 
vector[K]   X[N];
int<lower=1>  M;
vector[M-K]   FF;
matrix[M,M]   GG;
vector[M]  m0;
matrix[M,M]  C0;
}
parameters {
vector[M] theta[N]; 
real   H; 
cov_matrix[M]   Q; 

}
model {

theta[1] ~ multi_normal( m0 , C0 );

{ 
vector[M]           mu[N-1];

for (t in 2:N) {
mu[t] <- GG * theta[t-1] ;
theta[t] ~ multi_normal( mu[t] , Q );
}

}

{ 
real           mu2[N];

for (t in 1:N) {
mu2[t] <- FF' * head( theta[t] , M-K ) + X[t]' * tail( theta[t] , K ); 
Y[t] ~ normal( mu2[t] , H );
}

}

}
"
data <- list(N = length(y) ,             
             P = 1 ,
             M = 11 ,
             K = 5 ,
             Y = as.matrix( y ) ,
             X = cbind(rep( 1 , nrow(x) ) , as.matrix( x ) ) , 
                       FF = mod$FF[1:6],
                       GG = mod$GG,
             m0 = rep( 0 , 11 ),
             C0 = 1e+5 * diag(11)
             )

and this is the error

SAMPLING FOR MODEL 'modStan' NOW (CHAIN 1).
Error : INDEX OPERATOR [] OUT OF BOUNDS; index=1729; lower bound=1; upper bound=1728; index position=1; mu

error occurred during calling the sampler; sampling not done

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Error : INDEX OPERATOR [] OUT OF BOUNDS; can't find what is causing it
parts: The problem is here:

vector[M]           mu[N-1];
for (t in 2:N) {
mu[t] <- GG * theta[t-1] ;
theta[t] ~ multi_normal( mu[t] , Q );
}
mu has N-1 elements, but you're indexing it using t, which goes up to N. I would think that mu and theta would need to be the same length for the multi_normal call to work.

messages.author: 368f61d9252655a2
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Error : INDEX OPERATOR [] OUT OF BOUNDS; can't find what is causing it
parts:
Variance parameter H should be constrained, ie. real<lower=0>  H; It would probably be a good idea to give some prior distributions as well, for example cauchy(0,2.5) or something similar..

To really speed things up you could reparametrize the multivariate normal for theta's using Cholesky-decomposition. Take a look at "Multivariate Reparameterizations" in Stan manual page 182, link: https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/releases/download/v2.2.0/stan-reference-2.2.0.pdf
